crossRefs.note: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you…
As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for…
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all…
even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be…
What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has…
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting…
Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I…
Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
translations.bsb: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.
translations.kjv: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
translations.asv: Ye think all this time that we are excusing ourselves unto you. In the sight of God speak we in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
